_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleeya {player_id} long Tic Tac Toe.
Goall bilong yu em winim tri long lain (horisontal, vertikal, o diagonal) long borad.
Long tahn bilong yu, yu mas selektim namba bilong skwea (0-8) yu laik putim mark bilong yu insait narakai.
Olsem, '[4]' putim mark bilong yu long senta sel bilong borad.
Olsem Pleeya {player_id}, yu bai '{symbol}', wail yu yet bilong yu em '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dispela tok i no stret long pasin bilong raitim.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} em i no wanpela gutpela sel. Em mas stap namel long 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Pleeya {player_id} putim simbol bilong em ({symbol}) long sel {cell}.
